_meta.description: Independent/entrepreneurial earnings data for experiential roles. Complements BLS employed wages.
_meta.caveat: Self-reported data dominates. Survivorship bias in all sources. Revenue ≠ income (25-30% taxes + expenses). Always use median over mean.

breathwork-facilitator.title: Breathwork / Retreat Facilitator

independent_entry.notes: Many certified facilitators never reach full-time income

independent_established.notes: 9D aspirational claim: $109K-$218K. No verified survey data.

entrepreneurial_top.notes: No verified individual facilitator income data at top end

breathwork-facilitator.dataQuality: LOW-MEDIUM. No industry association survey exists. Best neutral figure: ZipRecruiter $49,774 (blends employed and self-employed).

fitness-coach.title: Fitness Coach / CrossFit Coach

independent_established.notes: Independent contractors earn 45% more than employed (IDEA 2025)

entrepreneurial_top.source: PTDC: online coaches with 100+ clients avg $127K

box_owner.notes: More than half take home $4K/mo or less. Mean skewed by top performers.

fitness-coach.dataQuality: MEDIUM-HIGH. PTDC (n=837) and BarBend (n=8,800) are real surveys. Self-reported but large samples.

podcast-host.title: Podcast Host

employed.notes: BLS category includes radio DJs, not just podcasters

independent_entry.source: Industry data: 85% of indie podcasters earn $0
independent_entry.notes: Only 15% report making any money. Only 26% actively monetizing.

independent_established.source: WNYC Werk It survey n=600: median $30-44/hr among profitable
independent_established.notes: Extreme survivorship bias. This only counts those who ARE profitable.

entrepreneurial_top.notes: Top 20 combined $638M. Joe Rogan $82M. Jay Shetty $21M.

podcast-host.dataQuality: HIGH at extremes (Forbes verified, BLS verified). LOW in the middle. The median podcaster earns $0.

chef-food-entrepreneur.title: Chef / Food Entrepreneur

employed.source: BLS OES May 2025 (Chefs and Head Cooks)

independent_entry.notes: Personal chef serving 2-5 weekly clients. Catering year 1: $20-40K net.

independent_established.source: ZipRecruiter avg private chef $82K, PayScale median $48/hr

entrepreneurial_top.source: UHNW household private chefs in NYC/LA/Aspen
entrepreneurial_top.notes: Plus brand revenue (courses, books, consulting) can add $100K+

chef-food-entrepreneur.failureRate: 60% of food trucks fail within first year
chef-food-entrepreneur.dataQuality: MEDIUM. No single authoritative survey. ZipRecruiter and PayScale provide best aggregated data.

life-career-coach.title: Life / Career Coach

employed.notes: BLS has no 'coach' category. Management Analysts is closest proxy.

independent_entry.notes: ~50% of coaching businesses fail within 5 years

independent_established.source: ICF/PwC 2025 Global Coaching Study n=10,000: US avg $71,719
independent_established.notes: Average pulled up by high earners. Median likely $45-55K given the 53% under $30K finding.

entrepreneurial_top.notes: Revenue from courses/groups not 1:1 sessions. Tiny fraction of coaches reach this.

life-career-coach.dataQuality: HIGH. ICF/PwC 2025 study (n=10,000+, 127 countries) is gold standard. Still self-reported.
